summary.text: Mark Kelly has been a U.S. Senator for Arizona since he was sworn in on December 2, 2020.

paragraphs.text: He earned a B.S. in marine engineering and nautical science from the U.S. Merchant Marine Academy and an M.S. in aeronautical engineering from the U.S. Naval Postgraduate School.
He was a U.S. Navy combat pilot who flew 39 combat missions in Operation Desert Storm and retired as a Captain, then was a NASA astronaut who made four trips into space and retired from NASA in 2011.
